people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: I have given you every place that the sole of your foot will tread on, as I told Moses.
translations.bsb: I have given you every place where the sole of your foot will tread, just as I promised to Moses.
translations.kjv: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.
translations.asv: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, to you have I given it, as I spake unto Moses.
